method: The listed basmati rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Start the 70g dry basmati rice first: this is the uncooked weight. Use the water quantity and cooking time on the rice packet; simmer until tender, then drain if the packet method requires it. Keep covered briefly while finishing the pan, then serve immediately.
Wash and drain the 100g spinach. Drain and pat dry the 180g firm tofu, then cut into 2cm cubes.

Warm a non-stick frying pan over a medium-low heat; this recipe does not include frying oil. Add the firm tofu and cook for 8–10 minutes, turning carefully until lightly golden on several sides and hot through. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Put the 120g chopped tomatoes and 25g medium curry paste into the same frying pan. Stir over a medium-low heat, then cover and simmer gently for 5 minutes. Stir twice; keep the heat low enough that the tomato liquid does not boil dry.
Add the washed spinach in two handfuls, cover for 1 minute, then stir. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until wilted throughout.

Return the cooked firm tofu and any collected juices to the pan; fold gently to keep the cubes intact. Heat everything together over a low heat for 2–3 minutes, stirring gently, until steaming hot throughout. Spoon over the freshly cooked rice and serve immediately.

review.notes: Golden tofu cubes, chopped tomatoes and wilted spinach in tomato curry sauce over basmati rice. No garnish, cream or additional vegetables; exact title matches.
